title: SU Art Museum opens galleries for free figure drawing session
summary: Syracuse University Art Museum is hosting a free public figure drawing session on November 19, 2026, featuring live model drawing among artworks created from recycled materials from San Francisco's Recology facility. This community arts event demonstrates cultural programming and public access to institutional resources.
